comment: Rein v2 MCP Server Registry. All servers must be listed here before they can be used with WRITE or EXECUTE permissions.

roles._comment: E-254 (claude-native-consolidation.md §Components 1): the only place that says which source directory serves which role. v4 is Claude-native, so both roles name the same src/claude/ directories, so both receive every skill; role-manifest.mjs unions directories and does not partition by name — role separation is enforced by the role token and the write gate (D-076). do_sync still unions shared with every role a provider serves.

task-synchronizer-mcp._note: Exclusive State Mutator (P-39): manages .ai/state.json, regenerates TASKS.md and REVIEWS.md as views
task-synchronizer-mcp._mandate: v3.1 (P-44): state.json is the exclusive write target. TASKS.md and REVIEWS.md are generated views only. Write tools reject calls when state.json is absent — run: rein migrate-state to seed it.

safe-exec-mcp._note: disable-model-invocation: true — Claude cannot self-authorize execution bypass

risk-analyzer-mcp._note: TSRT classifier — invoked automatically by rein update and rein review

archive-manager-mcp._note: Auto-Pilot Archive (P-27): monitors .ai/ context health and triggers archive when thresholds are exceeded

orchestrator-mcp._note: Deterministic workflow execution (P-38): replaces LLM-interpreted skills with programmatic orchestration. run_dispatch (E-92) is a read-only DAG dispatch planner.

memory-manager-mcp._note: §31 Cross-Project Memory Palace: stores high-level project signatures in ~/.rein/memory/signatures.json

verification-mcp._note: §32 Verification Audit: checks agent YAML frontmatter allowed-tools against registry; flags Ghost Tools as CRITICAL

patch-mcp._note: §25 Staleness-Aware Patching: MD5-verified atomic writes — prevents race-condition overwrites

token-budget-mcp._note: §27 Token Budget & Cost Governance: real-time LLM spend tracking persisted in ~/.rein/usage.sqlite

propose-patch-mcp._note: §30 Human-in-the-Loop Safe Diff Flow: propose_patch requires explicit confirm_patch before writing to disk

approval-mcp._note: E-10 HITL Gate: blocks Tier 3 ops until human types y/Y in terminal. Audit trail in ~/.rein/approvals.sqlite. Cannot be bypassed. Blueprint: interop.md §2. SEC_CLEARED 2026-04-24.
approval-mcp._security: T-HITL-001: ANSI stripped. T-HITL-002: DB_PATH hardcoded. T-HITL-003: stdin.isTTY required. T-HITL-004: SQLite write before response. T-HITL-005: maxLength 200/500 enforced.

advisor-mcp._note: E-9 A2A Bridge: the Engineer queries the Architect mid-execution via `claude -p`. Read-only — the Architect cannot write files. All rulings logged as [A2A_RULING] in .ai/LOG.md. Blueprint: interop.md §1.

cache-manager-mcp._note: E-11 Explicit Context Cache: assembles architect.md plus .ai/blueprints/*.md modified within 7 days into a prompt-cacheable System Context blob capped at 20,000 chars (E-275, D-075). mtime-based invalidation. Cache in ~/.rein/cache.sqlite. Blueprint: caching.md.
